instruction: Please open the video in VLC, select any frame, and save a snapshot as 'video_snapshot.png' on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to use VLC's snapshot feature (Video > Take Snapshot) to capture a still frame from the video and save it as 'video_snapshot.png' on Desktop. Evaluator checks if the image file exists and has reasonable size (min 5KB) indicating a valid image was captured.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: properly checks file existence and retrieves size at the exact path specified in instruction (/home/user/Desktop/video_snapshot.png)
Metric comparison logic is correct: validates both file existence and minimum size requirement (5000 bytes), ensuring a valid image was captured
Coverage is complete: evaluator verifies all requirements - file exists at correct location and has reasonable size indicating valid image
Data flow is correct: getter extracts file state using env.controller.get_file(), metric compares against expected rules (exists=true, min_size=5000)
Edge cases properly handled: metric handles non-existent files, files too small (corrupt/invalid), and invalid result format
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric properly accesses expected.get('exists') and expected.get('min_size') since framework passes rules dict directly
Expected values are semantically correct: min_size of 5000 bytes is appropriate for verifying a valid video snapshot, not an empty or corrupt file
